facts.fact: The article, citing an MNT-Halan prospectus, says Central Bank of Egypt rules for licensing payment system operators and payment service providers were issued in June 2025, and two Halan companies have applied for a licence.

EGY.note: Earned wage access is an employer-contract advance, not government payment.
